elements.label: Gameplay footage changes from rooftop punch game to Venice rooftop climbing game
Centered caption word swaps from 'new' to 'adventures'

sfx_review.label: impact
sfx_review.note: Sharp broadband onset with low-end weight, lands on the in-game punch burst (yellow spark explosion) just before the footage swap; not a reversed swoosh shape.

pattern.description: A single large white sans-serif word sits centred over gameplay footage and is replaced word-by-word ('new' -> 'adventures') on each footage cut; the footage change itself arrives with a short motion-blurred tilt into the new game.
pattern.why_premium: One-word-per-cut captions keep the line readable over busy gameplay and sync the edit rhythm to the sentence, with the punch impact SFX punctuating the switch.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.word-new',{autoAlpha:0}).set('.word-adventures',{autoAlpha:1}) at the cut; footage: gsap.fromTo('.clipB',{yPercent:-6,filter:'blur(16px)'},{yPercent:0,filter:'blur(0px)',duration:0.2,ease:'power3.out'}). Words swap with hard sets (or a 2-frame opacity tween), no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Per-word <Sequence from={cutFrame}> rendering one centered word; footage translateY/blur via interpolate(frame,[0,5],[-6,0]) with Easing.out(Easing.cubic). No spring.

notes: camera.move tilt_up reported by code; the visible blur at f1785 is the footage transition, labelled slide_down for content. The word swap appears to be a hard replace rather than an animated reveal.
